verdict.rationale: Figma Make's own docs show iterative chat-driven changes: starting new changes in parallel chats, annotations and draw-tool markup to target specific elements, and Make updating the data model and interface when fields are added. Code-change review and version history act as safety nets against regressions. However, nothing shows that follow-up prompts preserve existing working behavior, and there is no hands-on corroboration. Missing for 10: evidence that follow-up edits are scoped and do not regress existing functionality, independent or hands-on reports of multi-turn refinement stability.
